name: interrupt-clears-an-armed-destructive-request
description: A destructive request is armed by one Approve, then the person interrupts. The request is cleared without an answer, so a later Approve can never complete the confirmation.
reason: The interrupt is the strongest 'not this': an armed confirmation must not outlive the turn it belongs to.
source: Epic #92 rules 'interrupt clears pending permission' and 'the armed state resets on any other intent'; ticket #116; AppState.interruptClaude
